recipe_desc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.

bear.reason: secular leg: GenAI substitution bites Insights (78% of revenue); multi-year revenue decline; margin held above the COVID trough (FY2020 12.0%) on subscription cost flex; multiple at the own-history band-low (9.34).

base.reason: margin = 7yr clean median 18.45% ex the $150M FY25 goodwill impairment — the 14.13% anchor is dragged by the pre-2021 regime (five straight years ran 18-21%). Revenue = consensus FY26E. Multiple deliberately below the 22.7x own-history median: a decelerating top line doesn't re-earn the growth-era multiple.

bull.reason: turn proves cyclical: FY27E re-acceleration (+4%); margin near FY2023 best (20.94%); multiple toward but below own-history median.

revenue.method: DRAFT — ratify at review. Legs are set off the committed consensus path rather than round numbers: base IS consensus FY26E, bull IS consensus FY27E (the modelled re-acceleration), and bear takes a multi-year secular decline materially below FY26E to price the GenAI-substitution case.

Bear holds above the FY2020 COVID trough on subscription cost flex; base is the 7yr clean median; bull sits near the FY2023 best.
